review_description: Twyfords was great to deal with from the quote right through to the installation was all great.

A very smooth process from quote to instiiation, guys arrived on time went through the process wthout any hassle no real disruption to our routine,Matt & his crew very respectful . A very tidy job & all working great as expected.
I paid my deposit in late May and I am still waiting for someone to get back to me with a date for the installation. I find these guys quite unprofessional.

The entire process from the sales / quoting to the installation was handled very professionally. Shane has a fantastic knowledge of solar systems and offered some great advice. The installation team arrived on time and completed their works with a minimum of fuss. They cleaned up after themselves and gave expert operation instructions.Thank you Team TwyFord Electrical

Twyford organised everything weren’t pushy told me benefits and negatives of various systems panels, inverters battery etc promptly sent quotes and installed when they said they would installers were nice and explained system to me when all done. Good overall experience.

Overall sales was excellent Local company came out and looked at my place in QLD  We actually bought 2 systems  the other being in NSW house with solar quotes helpTwyford did a great job , tidy ,polite and explained how it worked
QUOTE WAS DONE ON TIME, KNOWLEDGABLE SALES PERSONINSTALLATION DONE WITHIN STATED TIME FRAME, ALL DONE IN ONE DAY, VERY TIDYYES EVERY THING WAS DONE FOR ME

After expressing interest in getting a quote, the company was very prompt and professional in their approach to our needs. Instillation was very professional and carried out with no hassles. After instillation the follow up service was very good.

Company representative, Shane, met me on site and produced a design that met my requirements. Installation crew were great and installation ran smoothly despite heavy rain interrupting the schedule. System is operating fine and Twyfords have arranged meter replacement with Ergon (energy retailer).
Spot on quoting, installation was done without a hitch and the customer service from Matt and Shane was nothing but top shelf

The installers were polite and professional. They arrived on the promised date and finished the job on that day. When they were finished, they carefully cleaned up after themselves.The whole process was smooth and easy and once the installation was finished, they contacted the power company to organize for connection to the grid.We couldn´t have asked for a better company than Twyford to provide our new Solar

Turned up on time and installed the system to how I wanted.  Very polite  careful installers. Showed me how to read the readout on the inverter and the app. Also replaced all the lights in the house at the same time. Highly recommend this provider for all your electrical work.

I had a great experience with these guys, they did what they said they would. I just made a call to them and they did everything it doesn't get any easier. I would definitely recommend them to friends and family
Promote and professional service. We have used Twyford Electrical twice now for the installation of solar panels. Great after installation service as well.

From start to finish Shane and the boys made the whole process of removing my failing system abs replacing with new keeping my .44c feed in easy. No pressure, great information and very knowledgeable not only on time but early for both quoting and install. Install lads were tidy and courteous.

Prompt and satisfactory quote with excellent explanations. All aspects of the process were dealt with for us. Some shade issues with an overhanging tree during winter however this will be rectified if system performance is inadequate once turned on and daily yield can be measured. We are currently waiting on our electricity provider to instal a new meter before the solar can be used.

Shane was great and not pushy at all and the boys did a wonderful job.They were on time, quick and efficient.I would recommend Twyford Solar to anyone who is looking for an honest and reliable installer

Very Efficient, answered most questions before they were asked, extremely knowledgeable especially on questions that we asked.The Installation was perform efficiently, they arrived on time and cleaned up afterwards. The team was very friendly and very professional work-wise and in appearance.Everything was well organised from woe to go.Their Customer Service was great with followup contact to make sure we were satisfied with the job.
very acceptable quote excellent workmanship  Installed  on time friendly workman

Sales quoting process was complete and easy for ignorant people like us.  Not a pushy sales tactic. In fact we waited more than 8 months before going ahead. Quote was written and emailed and very easy to understand.Installation was easy as they did all the work without any bother.All Installers were extremely polite, very tidy, and came when they said they would.Customer service afterwards has been exceptional. As I indicated we are pretty ignorant with the technology, but the help has been outstanding.Always get a local person as you get the best after sales service ever!
Boys did good job, good after sale service and good products.

The whole process from the time they come and met us, explained how it would work, how best we can make saving with the system and how they will always be connected should an issue come up. Installation from the team was A1 could not fault Twyford Solar & Electrical. Best Trades we have had.
